    List available GROBID Docker versions on Docker Hub

    grobid_docker_list_versions.Rd

    Queries the Docker Hub API to retrieve the list of available tags for a given GROBID image. Allows identifying usable versions with grobid_docker_start() or by modifying the default parameters via checkrefr_set_defaults().

    Usage

    grobid_docker_list_versions(
  repository = NULL,
  page_size = 100L,
  max_pages = 10L,
  verbose = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    repository

    character(1) or NULL. Name of the Docker Hub repository in the form "namespace/image". If NULL, automatically resolved from .checkrefr_env$docker_image (normally "lfoppiano/grobid"). Default: NULL.

    page_size

    integer(1) Number of results per queried page (max allowed by the Docker Hub API: 100). Default: 100L.

    max_pages

    integer(1) Maximum number of pages to browse, to avoid infinite pagination. Default: 10L.

    verbose

    logical(1) Display the formatted list in the console. Default: TRUE.

    Value

    tibble (invisibly) with columns name (tag), full_size (size in bytes), last_updated and digest. Sorted by last_updated descending.

    Details

    Uses the public unauthenticated endpoint: https://hub.docker.com/v2/repositories/grobid/grobid/tags/ (to be adapted according to the requested repository).

    See also

    grobid_docker_start()

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
grobid_docker_list_versions()
grobid_docker_list_versions(repository = "grobid/grobid")
} # }
